opener: Disposable fake OS opener; its generated link is opened in actual browser pages to emulate same-profile delivery. No real user profile is controlled.
stage: Host restart has one-click PC recovery, with a new credential and no terminal-copy requirement
checks: Launcher opens exactly the generated private loopback link

Reconnect without authentication gives the primary action without unlocking the editor
Secondary browser fallback rejects malformed or foreign private links without forwarding credentials

Fallback signs in, clears secrets and restores a real editable connection
A signed-in PC can type plain localhost again without an entry screen or opener
Private-link same-document navigation recovers the nonmodal entry page
A signed-out original tab can reconnect after a sibling signs this browser in
Open editor invokes the host opener without authorizing the calling page or returning secrets
An opener in another browser reaches a bounded, editable fallback and stops polling
